0.original: Liplu is never one to leave hard work unrewarded.

1.original: Liplu is grateful for your efforts and suggests that you lodge at the travel agency as reward. While you are waiting for your room to be made, you encounter a familiar pair: Fonjeantaine and Rediroq, who are in Yak T'el on a delivery. It seems the potsworn's work has been well received, much to the joy of the Moblin. Fonjeantaine thanks you for helping him find his confidence before saying his farewells, and as the two depart, Genuhanu arrives to show you to your lodgings.

2.original: Genuhanu seems almost starstruck as he expresses his pride in attending you. You take in the breathtaking scenery as you head to your lodgings, and yet another familiar voice calls out. It belongs to Tseeya, the Turali Travel Agency's first ever customer. Like the others before him, the worker from the Wing of Reflection has nothing but gratitude for your selfless contributions and seems certain that they will lead to a brighter Tural. After he takes his leave, you sit and ponder all the events that have led you to this moment, and then remember that Wawkesa wished to speak with you. You break from your reverie and head to the eatery to hear what the bandit-turned-chef has to say.

3.original: The diligent Wawkesa presents you with a hefty boxed meal as soon as you arrive, saying you are to bring it to Panaqpelu Retreat in Urqopacha, where Liplu awaits. Before you depart, however, the chef abashedly gives you his thanks for the mercy you showed him and his partners in crime after they kidnapped Wuk Lamat. Having said his piece, Wawkesa bids you farewell, and you set forth toward the hot springs of Panaqpelu Retreat.

4.original: Waiting for you at the hot springs is most everyone you have talked to throughout this mysterious odyssey. It seems this was all an elaborate plan to celebrate your efforts in revitalizing the various communities throughout Tural, and those present are eager to get to know you better. Food and drink are plenty, but before the party begins, Liplu suggests changing into something more fitting for the occasion.

5.original: The party kicks off with enough food and drink to feed a whole village, and its attendees regale each other with stories from their respective corners of Tural. A visit to the hot springs sees Ryoqor Terteh almost melt itself in the steaming waters, and a Pelu eater attempts to crash the festivities, but luckily disaster is averted in both cases. The party continues late into the night, with bonds being forged and horizons broadened. As the celebration winds down, you have a chat with Liplu, whose hard-but-secretive work brought this all together.

6.original: Liplu is happy that you had a chance to forget your responsibilities for even just a moment. However, all good things must come to an end, and before the party wraps up, you catch up with the other guests, starting with Ruvoll Ja.

7.original: Ruvoll Ja and Anggir are inspired to make Gok Golma into the pride of Mamook. In fact, they and Fahrafahr have a proposal for Liplu, and ask you to be there when they discuss it with the Pelu travel agent. In the meantime, you decide to catch up with Fahrafahr.

8.original: As with the others, Fahrafahr is optimistic about the future of her home, and it seems she is also eager to discuss the proposal with Liplu. Having spoken with everyone, you have one last chat with the host of the celebrations.

9.original: Liplu once again thanks you for coming to the party, and the rest of the guests express their mutual desire to bring the various disparate societies of Tural together as one. To that end, they decide to partner with the Turali Travel Agency to bring travelers and sightseers to their respective homes. While it remains to be seen what the future holds, the outlook has become just a little brighter thanks to food, drink, and hot springs.

26.original: Speak with Liplu at Panaqpelu Retreat.

48.original: Allow me to thank you for delivering those letters, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'll also offer my apologies for sending you hither and thither for such a minor task.

49.original: No doubt your feet ache and your back cries out for respite!

52.original: A single step further and my legs might fall off.

53.original: My shoulders and neck have hardly been so sore.

54.original: As expected from an adventurer of your caliber, you are positively indefatigable! Still, you did walk quite the distance, so I encourage you to take some time off to rest at our guest lodgings.

56.original: As I thought, even heroes require rest! Why not take a break at our guest lodgings?

57.original: Come to think of it, despite all the trials and tribulations you've endured for our sake, I don't believe you've had the chance to stay with us. So, how about it?

58.original: Good, good! I anticipated you might agree to my suggestion, so your chambers are being prepared as we speak.

59.original: Once they're ready, I'll have Genuhanu let you know. It shouldn't be long, but please make yourself at home in the meantime.

60.original: (-Familiar Voice-)Oh, is that... <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, is that you?

61.original: I thought so! It's been so long, I'm not sure if you remember me. It's Fonjeantaine, of the potsworn!

62.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... It is a pleasure to happygreet you here of all places! Have you come for craftytasks?

63.original: You're lodging here? Good for you. You always seem so busy, it's heartening to know you have the time to recuperate.

64.original: We are here on a delivery. Fonjeantaine's craftygoods have proven very popular as of late.

65.original: Fortunately for me. Customers have even made the journey all the way to Earthenshire to purchase them. I feel blessed that anyone would go to so much trouble for my work.

66.original: You played no small part in guiding me upon this path, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and for that I thank you.

67.original: Slowly but surely, I have overcome the impulse to compare myself to others, and become content simply to know my crafts bring joy to so many.

68.original: The seeds of that change were planted the day I met you and Wuk Lamat. And every day since then, I have become more certain that coming to Tural was the right choice.

69.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... But you cannot let success make you lazy. The life of an artisan is one of constant improvement!

70.original: When you are inspired with new ideas, quicktell Rediroq at once! That way you will always have what you need for your craftywork.

71.original: Since our business here is finished, it's about time we returned to Earthenshire. Rest well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and may we meet again!

72.original: A most hearty welcome to our special advisor! If you're ready to see your room, allow me to guide you.

73.original: I must admit, attending to one such as you is quite the emotional experience. We owe you so much...and we aren't the only ones.

74.original: We recently had a customer visit from distant Alexandria. They told us about the various troubles that had recently befallen their nation.

75.original: We recently had a customer visit from distant Alexandria. Apparently they had taken part in some sort of martial competition there, and they told us about the various troubles that had recently befallen their nation.

76.original: It was you and your companions that saw them through those dark times. When I heard that our special advisor was risking life and limb for the sake of others, I was worried. But I was also in awe.

77.original: You fly freely and nobly as Kixaihih, and the least we can do is offer you a place of respite from your trials. It is an honor, in fact.

78.original: Ah, but there I go rambling again. Please, allow me to show you to your room!

80.original: Please make yourself at home. If there is anything you need, anything at all, you only need ask.

81.original: Oh, but before I go, Liplu said that Wawkesa wished to speak with you. If you have a moment, could you visit the eatery later? Until then, please enjoy your stay.

82.original: (-???-)Well, this is a surprise. Come to visit old friends, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

85.original: Oh, you work for the Wing of Reflection, don't you?

86.original: Ah, who could forget Tseeya, the Turali Travel Agency's first customer.

87.original: Heh, I suppose a traveler of such renown can't be expected to remember every person <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> meets. I am Tseeya of the Wing of Reflection, your companion in arranging Rasafbaht's truly unforgettable experience.

88.original: I'm glad you remember. Then I suppose you also remember how much trouble we went through to ensure that Rasafbaht had an unforgettable experience.

89.original: I take it you've finally found time to relax. I've become quite fond of this place myself, and since my first tour I've arranged several more devoted entirely to fishing.

90.original: And since fate has brought us together again, there's something I've wanted to tell you ever since our last meeting.

91.original: Surely you've noticed the effect your actions have had on Tural. Long-standing issues that once gripped the nation now seem manageable.

92.original: A change set in motion more than eighty years ago, when Gulool Ja Ja stemmed the conflicts plaguing the continent and founded Tuliyollal. His Landsguard made the roads safe, and people could move more freely than ever before.

93.original: And with the Pelupelu given the mercantile reins, wares of all sorts flowed across Tural. But even so, its various peoples remained in their ancestral lands, following their established customs. The capital remained fundamentally separate.

94.original: However, Gulool Ja Ja had no intention of changing that. He understood that it would take time for a single “nation” of Tural to coalesce, and entrusted the next generation to see it realized.

96.original: With the succession of new Dawnservants, that new generation has come, and the Turali Travel Agency is but one of many enterprises reshaping our home. I hear that you aided some few of them, in fact.

97.original: People will have more chances to explore unfamiliar lands, more chances for mutual exchange. And as we come to better know our neighbors, we will learn to come together as a nation, and step forth into a brighter future.

99.original: I hadn't given it that much thought.

100.original: I was only adventuring as adventurers do.

102.original: I see. You were only doing what comes naturally, lending a helping hand to those in need.

103.original: To think actions that come so naturally to you would help revitalize a whole nation and the people who live within it. Such selflessness is truly moving.

105.original: I am grateful for your journey across Tural and for lending your strength to those you met. The Wing of Reflection shall do its utmost to ride these favorable winds as far as we can.

106.original: Now, I believe I've taken up enough of your time, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Rest well!

107.original: Time passes as you reflect upon the countless adventures that brought you to this moment...

108.original: After a lengthy reverie, you recall that Wawkesa wishes to speak with you. Perhaps he is still about at the eatery.

109.original: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Hope you were able to take your mind off things for a bit.

110.original: Heh, your face says it all. Here, cooked a little something up for you. I put my heart and soul into it, so you'd best hurry to your destination before it gets cold.

111.original: Didn't expect to be sent off so soon, did you? Liplu's waiting for you at Panaqpelu Retreat in Urqopacha─some hot springs run by another Pelupelu, as I understand.

112.original: But one thing before you go.

113.original: I just... Ah, I'll come out and say it. Back then with the Third Promise, all that kidnapping and whatnot...well, things weren't looking too bright after we ran into you.

114.original: 'Course, you were only doing right by your allies...but we'd never taken such a beating as you gave, nor been hounded so relentlessly afterwards. We were scared to death. When I saw you again, I was certain my final day had come.

115.original: But instead, my days have been full making food I love, and watching customers enjoy it. My old crew and I are even earning an honest wage...not bad for a bunch of former ne'er-do-wells. Not bad at all.

116.original: Our past crimes forgiven and our apologies taken at face value, all by the grace of you and Liplu. We owe you both a debt of gratitude we can never repay.

118.original: Still, maybe this meal will go some small way towards evening the scales. Best be off now to Urqopacha, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

119.original: Why, we meet again. While I would love to catch up, you should speak with Liplu first. She organized this whole affair, after all.

120.original: Murfurlur and I volunteered to guide Ruvoll Ja and the others from Yak T'el. They were splendid traveling companions.

121.original: Fahrafahr told us about the plan. We offered our assistance most eagerly─who would pass up an opportunity for a dip in these hot springs, after all?

122.original: You're finally here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. When the letter instructed us to come to Urqopacha, I jumped at the chance to see a new locale. It hasn't disappointed so far!

123.original: Liplu's proposal was too enticing to deny. Yet as excited as we all are, I have a feeling you'll be having the most fun.

124.original: There you are, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We've been waiting for you!

125.original: Did you bring the food Wawkesa made?

126.original: Good, good! Thank you for carrying it all this way. Now, shall we begin?

127.original: On behalf of all those who work towards the betterment of Yok Tural, I'd like to welcome the guest of honor─you!

128.original: Terribly sorry for keeping everything so secretive. I worried that you might shy away from attending this party if you knew what we were about.

131.original: I had a feeling something was going on.

132.original: I knew from the very first moment!

133.original: My, my, how perceptive! Though I shouldn't be surprised. Thank you, then, for playing along with this little game.

134.original: Originally, we had planned to hold this event at the travel agency. But as we heard more and more about your exploits around Tural, we began to envision something greater.

135.original: An event that would bring together everyone you've helped!

136.original: We've been wanting to thank you for everything you've done, so Liplu's invitation provided the perfect opportunity. Bol Tst'ei made almost too much food for us to carry!

137.original: We brought kirkahryar, the snow spirits' favorite libation, among other traditional Yok Huy fare. I hope everyone eats and drinks their fill.

138.original: Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits even expressed interest in coming. Perhaps their whims will guide them here at some point.

139.original: Look around you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. All these people from across Tural are here because of <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>. To show their gratitude to a dear friend.

140.original: Even so, a small matter weighs heavily on the hearts of all present...

141.original: You see, while you were a highly valued contributor to our project, we scarcely knew anything about you. Admittedly, the challenges we faced left us with little time for leisure, but even so...

142.original: People speak of your exploits in Tuliyollal quite often, and with each new story, I learn more and more of who you are. It made me realize how little we actually know of your life and that made me feel...somewhat sad.

143.original: More than as an advisor, helper, or artisan, I'd like to know you as a person.

144.original: We all feel that way, you can be sure! So if it isn't too much trouble, we'd like you to tell us all about your life both within Tural and without!

145.original: But before that, why don't you change into something less dusty from travel? This is a party, after all, and we'd like you to relax.

146.original: All present are eager to speak with the guest of honor. Why not match their festive mood with equally festive attire? Battle will not be required of you during this quest.

147.original: This will be a good opportunity to strengthen our ties with the people of Yak T'el, as well. I look forward to hearing about your time with them.

148.original: Liplu has reserved the venue for the rest of the day. Gigimolu would love this, fond of hot springs as he is, but unfortunately he's already on his way back to Eorzea.

149.original: Apparently the beasts in these parts sometimes prey upon Pelupelu who have warmed their bodies in the hot springs. One of Nopli's trading partners almost met their end here, in fact.

150.original: I'm interested to see what crops are grown in Urqopacha and Kozama'uka. Hopefully I can take some samples home with me for research.

151.original: After you delivered my letters, I came here to wait for everyone while you were resting at the travel agency. We managed to get everything ready just before you arrived.

152.original: These secluded hot springs are the pride of the Pelupelu. The healing waters soothe back pain, sore muscles, and flagging spirits. Hopefully they provide some small measure of relief from your tireless adventuring.

153.original: Are you wearing that to the party?

154.original: Begin the party with your current gear?

155.original: Very well! Now, bring out the food and drink!

156.original: I did not expect Ryoqor Terteh to be so curious about the hot springs. To think it would actually try to enter those scalding waters... A sight I'll not soon forget, haha!

157.original: That Pelu eater gave me quite the fright! But Murfurlur ensured that the party could continue unabated─he looks pleased with himself, doesn't he?

158.original: This party is in your honor, so it was only right that I stopped that hungry beast. My skill as a bodyguard has improved, has it not? I have your guidance to thank for that, too.

159.original: Everyone's stories gave me a clearer picture of Tural as a whole, and Liplu even arranged for me to visit the fields of reeds. This day proved to be more fruitful to my research than I imagined.

160.original: The food you brought was delicious! Maybe we should invite this Wawkesa to Gok Golma? My mouth waters to think what he and Bol Tst'ei might come up with if they put their heads together.

161.original: What a grand time that was! Were you able to forget your worries, if even but for a moment?

163.original: It's been a while since I was so relaxed.

164.original: Would that I had more time.

165.original: Our next party should be at the travel agency.

166.original: I'm glad to hear that. You throw yourself into one battle after another, don't you? I doubt any of us could keep up if our lives depended on it!

167.original: Surely no one would begrudge you a little rest and recuperation from time to time.

168.original: I'm sure everyone here shares that sentiment. You throw yourself into one battle after another, don't you? I doubt any of us could keep up if our lives depended on it!

169.original: Surely no one would begrudge you a little rest and recuperation from time to time.

170.original: That's a great idea! That way, Wawkesa and anyone who couldn't make it this time can join. We can close the travel agency for a day and have a proper celebration!

171.original: Of course, we'll invite everyone again. Wuk Evu, Tseeya, and Mablu would also love to come... Yes, let's do it sooner rather than later!

172.original: Now, I'm sure the others would like to speak with the guest of honor. Why don't you indulge them?

173.original: Everyone's here to speak with the guest of honor─you! Why don't you see what they have to say?

174.original: It's been a pleasure listening to your many fantastic tales, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

175.original: But even after hearing your stories, I have trouble imagining them. One day I hope to see those “space carrots” with my own eyes!

176.original: Your journey gives us the motivation we need to make the gainery even better. You might even hear talk of Gok Golma at whatever far-flung locale your next adventure takes you!

177.original: And with outside orders increasing by the day, maybe it's time to dream bigger. Be more ambitious!

178.original: We'll make the people of Mamook proud!

179.original: Ah, I forgot to mention. Fahrafahr, Anggir, and I came up with an interesting idea. We want to see what Liplu thinks, and we hope you'll stick around to hear her thoughts!

180.original: I've been thinking about the future of Gok Golma─of all Mamook, in fact. We've come up with a proposal for Liplu, and we'd like you to be there when we discuss it!

181.original: Crops take root in the land, then bear fruit that forms the seeds of the next generation. In the same way, I hope Gok Golma bears seeds of lasting change for Mamook.

182.original: I can't remember the last time I stopped worrying about my duties and simply lived in the moment. Not since Dartorgor's passing, I think... Yet when I saw Ryoqor Terteh's joy writ so plain on its face, I realized anew all the work was worth it.

183.original: With Zirgorteh the Open-armed now restored, the time has come to look towards the future─to take this precious opportunity to decide how we wish to live our lives.

184.original: Oh, I can only hope that means more business opportunities for us!

185.original: I shall leave the counting of coin to Master Nopli. Yet if you ever require protection for any reason, I am always willing to lend my arm.

186.original: I am glad for the offer!

187.original: Speaking of which, we had a proposal of our own to share with Liplu before departing. I am glad I had the chance to speak with you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, as well as everyone else gathered here.

188.original: We intend to share our proposal with Liplu shortly. An idea for which we have this gathering to thank.

189.original: What does the future hold for Zirgorteh the Open-armed? For all of Worlar's Echo? I understand Fahrafahr's desire to plan ahead.

190.original: With the fellowship between the Yok Huy and snow spirits restored, Urqopacha feels blessed by favorable winds. Wherever they may lead us, I intend to continue safeguarding others, if only to repay the debt I owe you.

191.original: At the risk of repeating myself, I'd like to thank you again for coming here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

192.original: But that hardly begins to scratch the surface, doesn't it? For the time you've given us, and all the help you've offered, I owe you a debt I'm not likely to repay any time soon.

193.original: We wouldn't have come nearly as far without you, that's for sure. And now...

194.original: ...In bringing us all together like this, you've given us opportunities for new endeavors. After a bit of discussion, we've come to realize our goals align almost perfectly.

195.original: Yes, I want people to know that life in Worlar's Echo has changed. That the snow spirits are no longer feared, but embraced, and that together we wish to shed the settlement's reputation as an isolated mountain community.

196.original: We all share similar goals. We would like the various peoples of Tural to remember each other not as strangers with esoteric customs, but as trusted neighbors.

197.original: To that end, we have a proposal for you, Liplu. Might we partner with the Turali Travel Agency? We would like travelers from across the continent to see our respective homes as they are now.

198.original: That sounds like a wonderful plan! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, as our special advisor, what are your thoughts?

201.original: I think you anticipated this would happen.

202.original: I think your inner abacus has already given you the answer.

203.original: Yes, in fact, my inner abacus has been clacking away furiously! Of course, I'm always looking for new opportunities for expansion, but believe me when I say celebrating <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> has been my top priority from the start.

204.original: While we Pelu use commerce to build bridges between peoples, you bring them together through high adventure! How many others could say the same?

205.original: ...Now, while I regret to say it, I suppose this little gathering must draw to a close.

206.original: Don't be a stranger around Gok Golma, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

207.original: Come check in on Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits, too! We will make a special batch of kirkahryar just for you.

208.original: Surely you're already thinking of your next escapade, yes? Well, let's give you a hero's farewell!

209.original: May we meet again soon, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! And may the road ahead of you be laden with good fortune!

210.original: You have achieved <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Allied<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> reputation with the Turali Travel Agency, the farmers of Gok Golma, and the Hands of Zirgorteh.

211.original: Through your efforts, your allies of all shapes and sizes across Tural have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies across the continent!
